project.name: Stellar Collision — Conversation Canvas
project.thesis: Conversations are collisions of perspectives. Visualize the overlap, navigate the tension, discover shared territory.
project.tagline: Two stellar maps collide. Where they connect is where conversation happens.

core_concept.description: Two parties each generate their own constellation of ideas (mental models, tensions, questions, context). The meeting interface merges both constellations into a collision space where nodes attract (shared interest), repel (misalignment), or create new gravity (unexpected connections).
core_concept.visual_principle: Anschauung — what the eye catches at first glance must performatively communicate the concept
core_concept.first_glance_intuition: Two people. Two perspectives. They're colliding. Some ideas connect. Some repel. The space between them is where the conversation happens.

use_case.primary: Exploratory business meetings where both parties want to discover alignment without formal agendas

mental_models.label: The Working Triangle
mental_models.description: Change Management × AI Adoption × Business Reality. These three forces create tension — and that tension is where value emerges.
details: Change Management: How humans adapt to new systems and workflows
AI Adoption: Making intelligence operational, not just theoretical
Business Reality: Where the model meets execution constraints
mental_models.note: The real work happens at the intersections — not inside the vertices.

mental_models.label: Interface as Leverage
mental_models.description: AI's value isn't just in generating intelligence — it's in making that intelligence navigable and usable. The interface is the real bottleneck.
details: Maps instead of lists: Spatial orientation over linear overload
Interaction over generation: Human steers, AI executes
Bandwidth management: Humans filter by navigation, not by reading
mental_models.note: The next UX paradigm isn't about better prompts — it's about better surfaces to explore AI-generated possibility spaces.

mental_models.label: Serendipity Over Productivity
mental_models.description: AI adoption narratives over-index on efficiency and productivity. But the real unlock is serendipity — discovering insights you weren't looking for.
details: Exploration vs. optimization: Wandering beats targeting for discovery
Side-door insights: The best findings emerge from adjacent exploration
Low-stakes experimentation: Remove friction, increase surface area
mental_models.note: Productivity is table stakes. Serendipity is the strategic advantage.

tensions.label: Intelligence vs. Usability
tensions.description: Models get smarter, but interfaces stay dumb. The gap between AI capability and human operability is widening, not shrinking.

tensions.label: Model Power vs. Workflow Reality
tensions.description: What a model *can* do and what a user *will* do are entirely different problems. Most AI rollouts fail at the second, not the first.

tensions.label: Data Richness vs. Human Bandwidth
tensions.description: More data doesn't mean better decisions. It means cognitive overload. The interface needs to manage attention, not just display information.

tensions.label: AI Capability vs. Trust Threshold
tensions.description: Clinical workflows demand trust. But trust isn't built through accuracy alone — it's built through explainability, predictability, and user control.

tensions.label: Platform Neutrality vs. Actionability
tensions.description: SOPHiA positions as neutral intelligence. But neutrality without clear next-action pathways creates decision paralysis, not empowerment.

tensions.label: Multimodal Integration vs. Fragmented Workflows
tensions.description: Genomics + imaging + clinical data = powerful insights. But if they require three different navigation models, users won't integrate them.

questions.label: How do clinicians navigate multimodal outputs in practice?

strategic_principles: Anschauung — visual form must performatively communicate conceptual function
Collision not canvas — two perspectives merging, not one person presenting
Serendipity-driven navigation — where nodes glow brightest = where conversation should start
Modular onboarding — future vision is dual LLM generation, prototype is manual authoring
Template reusability — this pattern works for any exploratory meeting, not just SOPHiA
